title: Telemetry Settings v1
description: Rig Relay telemetry settings. Separates local operational telemetry (required for governed mode) from remote beta data sharing (optional). Supports three modes: basic_local, governed_local, beta_orchestration.

mode.description: Current operation mode: basic_local (no remote sharing, no orchestration), governed_local (local telemetry only, no remote sharing), beta_orchestration (remote sharing enabled, advanced features).

local_operational_enabled.description: Local operational telemetry: required for governed mode. Powers receipts, dirty-file guard, coordination, current_state, checkpointing, replay/debug.

local_derived_datasets_enabled.description: Local derived datasets: required for current_state, reports, queue planning, inspector.

remote_beta_sharing_enabled.description: Remote beta data sharing. During private beta, advanced orchestration features require this to be enabled.

share_level.description: What data may be shared remotely if remote_beta_sharing_enabled is true.

participant_id.description: Anonymous participant identifier (e.g. anon_<hex>). Generated or set during onboarding.

onboarding_acknowledged_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the user acknowledged onboarding.

onboarding_text_version.description: Version of onboarding text shown to the user.

destination.description: Remote destination identifier (e.g. google_drive, local, custom).

disabled_features.description: List of features disabled based on current settings.

warnings.description: Non-fatal warnings about the current settings.

degradation_mode.description: Degradation level computed from telemetry booleans: full (all enabled), degraded (some disabled), disabled (local telemetry off).

degraded_capabilities.description: List of capability names that are degraded or unavailable under current settings.

degradation_reason.description: Human-readable explanation of why telemetry is degraded or disabled.

degraded_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the degradation mode was computed.
